Articulated silver-blue plate, every panel engraved with frost-rune knotwork — fitted cuirass, flared pauldrons, and tapered greaves over a charcoal gambeson. A half-cape of storm-grey wool clips at one shoulder. Glacial-pass Noldor knight, combat-ready and severe.

Oxblood fitted leather cuirass, brass-riveted across the sternum, over a cream linen underlayer. Tooled bracers wrap both forearms; a crossed sword-and-dagger harness rides her back. No cloak, no coat — Dúnedain ranger moving light through Eriador summer.

Dark chitin-and-hide breastplate, lacquered deep teal, articulated at the waist like beetle-shell segments. Shoulder-guards of layered chitin over bare arms — tattooed, battle-worn. A single short dagger rides the left hip. Chultan jungle fighter, hot climate, unencumbered.

Pewter half-plate, the cuirass hammered into subtle feminine contour and etched with Cormyrean lion-reliefs. Layered tassets over fitted riding breeches, steel gorget, short-cuffed gauntlets. A wine-red surcoat underlayer shows at the hem. Temperate, mounted, authoritative.

Fitted forest-green scale armor, each lamellar plate edged in verdigris-bronze, descending from a sleek breastplate to a mid-thigh skirt-of-scales. No hood, no coat. Bosmer scout, warm-temperate forest, the armor doing all the talking.

The breastplate is the whole statement — blackened steel, hand-engraved with Leyndell sunburst spirals, fitted over a dark-amber quilted underlayer. Pauldrons flare like wings. Gauntlets and greaves complete the set. Elden Ring Leyndell knight, imposing, ornate.

Reinforced russet leather cuirass over a sleeveless gambeson, leaving her tattooed arms free. Studded shoulder-pauldrons, tooled bracers to the elbow, a scimitar slung low on her hip. Hammerfell-Redguard mercenary, warm climate, warrior silhouette.

Cobalt-lacquered lamellar chest-piece, each plate pinned with brass rivets in Quel'Thalas geometric patterns, over a fitted indigo underlayer. No cloak. Slim pauldrons and articulated vambraces. An elf archer built for speed and ceremony both.

Matte bone-white plate, the gorget and pauldrons sculpted into Carian lunar-arch motifs. Fitted breastplate, articulated hip-guards, greaves over dark wool riding breeches. A short ivory half-cape catches at the right shoulder. Liurnia sorcerer-knight, cold, severe, Elden Ring-caliber.

No armor at all above the waist except tooled leather bracers and a studded shoulder-harness for twin short blades. Below: fitted dark-teal breeches tucked into knee-high boots. Waterdhavian rogue, temperate city setting, athletic and lethal.

A fitted battlemage coat-armor in deep charcoal, the chest panel reinforced with sewn rune-plates of dull silver, cinched at the waist with a wide brass-buckled belt. Overlapping scale at the shoulders. Thayan Red Wizard turned field-commander. Warm climate, no hood.

Sand-tan fitted leather cuirass with heat-bleached pauldrons, brass corner-rings, and a sun-cloak draped behind her — never over the armor. Breeches and low wrapped boots. Haradrim-coded desert adventurer, single-layer construction, hot-climate high fantasy.

Steel-grey articulated plate from gorget to greaves, every joint polished, the cuirass stamped with Gondorian White Tree roundels. She carries no shield — a long bastard sword replaces it. Combat-worn, not ceremonial. Temperate, Gondorian, cover-caliber.

Ironborn-flavored: dull iron brigandine, each small plate sea-stained and re-hammered. Fitted over a dark wool arming coat, heavy vambraces, no cape. Salt-corroded rivets. She looks like she swam ashore and kept fighting. Cold coast, lived-in, brutal.

Saffron underlayer visible at collar and wrist beneath a fitted olive-drab leather cuirass with bronze scale inserts. Light, single-layer, warm-climate build — a Stranglethorn expedition fighter moving fast through jungle heat.

Amethyst-purple fitted half-plate, the breastplate surface etched with Carian star-charts, over a dark violet arming doublet. Articulated pauldrons, flared greaves. A matching purple half-cape snaps at the right clasp. Elden Ring sorcerer-knight archetype, cold upland, ornate.

Deep jade fitted scale cuirass, the overlapping plates each edge-burnished gold, over a black underlayer. Slim pauldrons, no hood. A High-Elf Galadhrim archer on a temperate forest path — armor as elegant as it is lethal.

Nilfgaardian-coded: matte black articulated plate, the cuirass inlaid with thin gold sun-sigil lines. Perfectly fitted, gorget to tasset. A dark half-cape hangs from the left pauldron. No ornament beyond the inlay. Cold, imperial, Witcher-caliber severe.

Worn amber-brown leather scout coat — hip-length, belted hard, never loose — over a studded-leather underlayer. Crossed shortbow quivers on her back. Bosmer ranger, temperate, coat as functional armor layer, not draping decoration.

The entire palette is coral-pink and burnished copper — a fitted Highgarden-Reach knight in ceremonial half-plate, the breastplate engraved with climbing roses, short tassets over pale breeches. A coral tabard peeks at the hem. Warm-temperate, mounted, ornate.

Fitted dark-brown hide cuirass layered over a bearskin mantle — the fur draped back like a half-cape, never obscuring the armor. Iron-banded bracers, heavy greaves. Free-Folk northern warrior, cold climate, hide-and-iron construction.

Skellige-flavored blue-grey mail hauberk, fitted at the waist with a wide iron-studded leather belt. Engraved pauldrons, bare forearms, iron vambraces. No hood, no coat. Cold maritime setting, mid-armored, the belt and pauldrons doing the silhouette work.

Fitted drow spider-silk underlayer beneath a chitin-plate cuirass, the surface etched with Underdark glyph-spirals in deep violet and black. Slim articulated vambraces, low-profile pauldrons. A dark short-cape clips at the neck. No daylight, all menace.

Cream-and-gold fitted plate — a paladin's half-plate, the breastplate relief-stamped with sunburst Holy Symbol, over a white arming coat. Articulated gorget, short greaves. She wears no cloak. Temperate Cormyrean templar, formal and unyielding.

A single sleeveless reinforced leather jerkin in deep russet, brass shoulder-studs, bare arms wrapped in fighting-cord to the knuckle. Fitted breeches, no coat, no hood. School-of-Wolf Witcher build, warm-season road, pure athletic warrior economy.

Articulated silver-blue plate fits her torso like a second skin — engraved pauldrons, fluted vambraces, a gorget etched with frost-runes. A half-cape of storm-grey wool snaps at her shoulder clasp. Glacial-pass Noldor armory, built to move.

Oxblood-lacquered lamellar cuirass over a charcoal gambeson, brass rivets running in precise diagonal rows. Fitted greaves, no pauldrons. Arms bare from the elbow, both forearms wrapped in tooled leather bracers stamped with Dúnedain tracking-sigils.

Dark chitin plates harvested from a Chultan crawler, shaped and lacquered to her torso. Twin dagger-sheaths cross her chest over the cuirass, not instead of it. Fitted leather breeches, knee-high boots with steel toe-caps. Combat-ready, jungle-dark.

Verdigris-bronze scale cuirass, each plate hand-hammered and slightly convex, cascading to a short skirt of articulated scale over fitted wool riding breeches. No cloak. Greaves buckled over tall boots. A Cormyrean knight on campaign, mid-weight and fast.

The breastplate is blackened steel, acid-etched with branching Liurnia sigils. Fitted pauldrons, one larger than the other. A long ashen-white half-cape hangs from the left shoulder only. Greaves over dark breeches. Everything deliberate, nothing decorative without function.

Fitted studded-leather jerkin, deep forest-green, worn over a linen undershirt rolled to the bicep. Shoulder-harness carries a short sword and a hand-crossbow. Tooled bracers cover her forearms. Tattooed arms, lean silhouette — a Bosmer scout who has never worn a hood she didn't need.

Pewter-grey half-plate — breastplate, pauldrons, vambraces, and cuisses — articulated at every joint with riveted leather strips. A surcoat in faded wine-red covers the torso plate, heraldry worn to suggestion. Gondorian campaign armor, dented at the left pauldron from something large.

Sand-tan fitted leather cuirass reinforced with bone-white horn strips along the ribs. Sleeveless — her arms free, biceps marked with pale Redguard ward-scars. A sun-cloak ties at the throat and falls to the hip over nothing else warm. Built for heat and open country.

The coat-armor is cobalt wool stiffened with plates of boiled leather at chest, ribs, and spine — a battlemage's solution. Runic stitching in silver thread runs the seams. Fitted to the waist, flaring slightly at the hip over trousers. Carian Academy pragmatism.

Ironborn-forged blackened brigandine — hundreds of small steel plates sewn inside dark canvas, fitted tight across the chest. Salt-eaten at the hem. Vambraces over bare forearms. No cloak, no softness. She smells like iron and seawater.

Amber-gold cuirass with deep relief engravings of rearing horses across the chest, paired with matching pauldrons. Russet travelling cloak pins at the right shoulder and whips behind her. Rohirrim heavy cavalry kit, polished for the muster, already showing hard-road dust at the boot.

Fitted wolf-hide cuirass over a grey underlayer, School-of-Wolf stitching reinforcing the joins. No pauldrons — mobility over protection. Crossed steel-grey sword-straps over the back, bracers of dark boiled leather. A Witcher's gear that has been repaired more than once.

Matte jade-green scale armor — slim lamellar plates laced with dark cord, fitted from collar to hip. Sindar forest-ranger design: wide enough to draw a bow, quiet enough not to rattle. Greaves over moss-dark breeches. No decoration except the carved tip of each scale.

No outer layer at all — just a fitted indigo gambeson quilted in diamond patterns, steel-capped at the shoulders with small articulated plates. Leather breeches, ankle boots. Her scimitar rides high on the hip-ring. Light, fast, Waterdhavian street-bred and proud of it.

Heavy Leyndell ceremonial plate in cream-and-gold, still worn for war. The breastplate bears a sun-wheel pressed in bas-relief. Pauldrons, gorget, articulated gauntlets. A deep saffron tabard beneath it, edge-worn. Moves like the armor has been hers since childhood because it has.

Dunmer battle-leather in charcoal and volcanic-glass trim — fitted cuirass with ash-grey scale inserts at the sternum, vambraces engraved with House sigils. Her arms bare above the elbow. Dark teal underlayer visible at collar and cuffs. Built for the caldera, not the cold.

Coral-pink-and-cream Highgarden plate, lighter than it looks — articulated breastplate, fluted pauldrons, etched with climbing roses pressed flat so they catch no blade. She wears it with fitted dark breeches rather than a skirt. The armor is ornate; the rider is not.

Free-Folk hide-and-fur armor, but fitted and deliberate: layered elk-hide cuirass hardened with tree-resin, bone-plate inserts at the shoulder, bracers of mammoth-leather. Fur trim at collar only. Sword across the back. The cold is not the point — she just doesn't take it off.

Rusted-amber Nilfgaardian half-plate, the sun sigil pressed on the breastplate in black enamel. Pauldrons, vambraces, and articulated knee-guards over fitted riding breeches. A long black half-cape — just a half-cape — clips at the gorget and leaves her sword arm fully free.

Amethyst-purple fitted leather cuirass, tooled with fine geometric patterns, worn over a cream linen undershirt. Bracers matching. No shoulder armor — she trades the protection for draw-speed on the short bows across her back. Quel'Thalas ranger cut, built for canopy, not siege.

Knight-Errant: Articulated silver-blue plate engraved with frost-rune knotwork across every panel, fitted cuirass and flared pauldrons over a charcoal gambeson, tapered greaves worn to a road-grey patina, a half-cape of storm-grey wool clipped at one shoulder, scabbard riding her left hip.

Ranger: Oxblood fitted leather cuirass brass-riveted across the sternum over a cream linen underlayer, tooled vambraces wrap both forearms, a crossed sword-and-dagger shoulder harness rides her back, quiver angled at the hip, no cloak, every edge road-scuffed and dark with trail-grime.

Tribal Warrior: Dark chitin-and-hide breastplate lacquered deep teal, articulated at the waist in beetle-shell segments, layered chitin spaulders over arms tattooed with clan-mark spirals, a broad tooled belt hung with bone toggles, a short curved blade sheathed at the hip, every surface scratched and sand-worn.

Battlemage: Iron-grey lamellar chest-piece over a deep-midnight-blue fitted arming doublet, each lamella etched with rune-chain script, articulated leather pauldrons reinforced with riveted steel strips, runic vambraces glowing faintly at the seams, a short sword at the hip, the whole assembly road-dusty and one pauldron strap replaced with raw leather cord.

Inquisitor: Matte blackened-steel half-plate breastplate pressed with the order-flame crest, worn over a charcoal brigandine visible at the flanks, steel pauldrons edged in tarnished brass scripture, gauntlets articulated to the knuckle, a long coat of boiled leather serving as a back-guard, road-grimed and one gauntlet finger bent from a past fight.

Oathbreaker: Cracked and re-lacquered midnight-blue plate, the original sworn-order engravings scored through with deliberate blade-marks, mismatched pauldrons one steel and one dark leather, a tattered tabard in faded silver hanging from a single chest-ring, twin short swords crossed at the back, every surface carrying the story of the breaking.

Beastmaster: Tawny hide-and-lamellar chest piece tooled with beast-claw patterns, articulated at the waist over a rust-brown linen base, reinforced leather vambraces strapped with thick cord for raptor perching, a wide utility belt carrying trap-tools and bone-handled knives, greaves stitched from layered hide, the whole assembly claw-scarred and trail-dark.

Spellsword: Fitted silvered-steel cuirass inlaid with arcane circuit-etchings in brass, over a forest-green arming doublet with mail gussets at the shoulders, slim articulated pauldrons, runic vambraces that dim when the blade is sheathed, a longsword at the hip, travel-worn to a warm patina with one inlay line scratched open.

Shieldmaiden: Deep-riveted iron-grey plate cuirass over a cream wool gambeson, broad engraved pauldrons carrying clan-ring etchings, articulated greaves worn to a scuffed shine, a round boss-shield slung at the back by a wide leather harness, broad vambraces tooled with interlace knotwork, the whole kit dented and road-hardened.

Warden: Moss-darkened boiled leather breastplate over a grey fitted hauberk, chest tooled with woodland-glyph borders, articulated leather pauldrons reinforced with riveted steel, vambraces engraved with branch-and-thorn patterns, a short-sword at the hip and a hunting horn at the belt, every edge stained with bark and trail-mud.

Hexblade: Bone-white fitted plate, every panel etched with asymmetric hex-sigils in tarnished iron inlay, worn over a smoke-grey gambeson, one pauldron broader and ridged, iron-dark gauntlets articulated to the wrist, a glyph-scarred blade at the left hip, the whole set road-grimed and one hex-line burned open by old spell-bleed.

Vengeance-Paladin: Ember-orange and blackened-steel half-plate, the cuirass face stamped with a broken-halo crest, worn over a deep wine-red brigandine, articulated vambraces engraved with judgment-scripture now half-worn to illegibility, heavy greaves, a two-handed blade slung at the back, the plate streaked with old fire-char and fresh road-dust.

Pathfinder: Desert-tan hardened leather cuirass over a linen base in undyed cream, chest tooled with compass-rose and survey-line etchings, slim articulated spaulders, a wide map-case strap crossing the chest, vambraces with measuring-rule marks etched in brass, knee boots road-worn pale, a hand-axe at one hip and a short blade at the other.

Wandering Captain: Iron-grey fitted breastplate worn over a deep-forest doublet, the plate etched with a campaign-list border of cities and forts, pauldrons showing weld-repairs over old battle damage, officer-grade tooled vambraces, a sword-knot worn to silk-thread rags at the hilt, and a commander-cape of storm-grey wool cut short and road-frayed.

Witch-Hunter: Blackened-steel fitted half-plate over a wine-red fitted brigandine, chest marked with iron-inlaid warding-eye sigils, slim articulated pauldrons, vambraces engraved with hex-break scripture, a wide belt hung with silver-vial pouches and a crossbow-bolt bandolier, knee-high boots worn dark with road-muck, no decoration that is not also a weapon.

Glaive-Master: Iron-grey lamellar cuirass articulated at every waist-rib over a rust linen base, deep-fluted pauldrons providing arc-swing clearance, reinforced leather vambraces laced from wrist to elbow, greaves with shin-ridge engraving, a glaive carried diagonally across the back in a fitted spine-harness, the whole kit dented and edge-notched from heavy use.

Stormcaller: Frost-pale fitted plate, each panel etched with storm-circuit runes in tarnished silver, worn over a deep-midnight arming doublet, pauldrons arcing wide and ridged, gauntlets articulated to every knuckle with etched storm-eye inlays, a short stabbing blade at the hip, the plate carrying long scorch-lines from old lightning-bleed.

Demon-Hunter: Matte blackened-steel breastplate chased with demon-ward wards in antique brass, fitted over a smoke-grey hauberk, articulated pauldrons spiked at the crown, cross-draw twin-blade harness riding both hips, vambraces tooled with binding-chain patterns, greaves worn mirror-dull on the shin-edge from crouched stone-scrambles, the whole assembly battle-dark and bone-scarred.

Veteran Knight: Heavily patinated silver-grey plate, older campaign-engravings worn nearly smooth on the cuirass face, mismatched greaves one newer than the other, a gambeson showing beneath in faded ash-blue, articulated pauldrons bearing a half-effaced order-crest, road-worn sabatons, and a single longsword at the hip with a hilt-wrap of replaced cord.

Frost-Maiden: Ice-blue lacquered scale hauberk over a frost-pale fitted gambeson, each scale stamped with a tundra-sigil and worn at the edges to bare steel, articulated pauldrons flared like layered ice-shards, vambraces etched with permafrost-map lines, heavy greaves with knee-ridge detailing, a short curved sword at the hip, the whole assembly wind-scoured and cold-patinated.

Disgraced Templar: Tarnished antique-brass cuirass, the order-phoenix crest hammer-defaced but still visible through the damage, worn over a deep-charcoal gambeson with mail sleeves, mismatched pauldrons both scarred, vambraces bearing scripture that has been scratched through and re-engraved with something rawer, a sword at the hip, the whole kit road-filthy and carrying the weight of a broken oath.

Sand-Lancer: Deep-rust fitted brigandine over a desert-tan arming doublet, chest panels brass-riveted in diagonal lance-chevron patterns, articulated leather pauldrons with tooled dune-spiral borders, slim vambraces engraved with oasis-sigil chains, a long lance in a spine-harness crossing the back, knee-high boots worn pale at the toe, every surface grit-scoured and sun-bleached at the edges.

Knight-Errant: Articulated silver-blue plate engraved with frost-rune knotwork at every panel edge, fitted cuirass over a charcoal gambeson, flared pauldrons riveted with antique brass, tapered greaves road-scuffed at the shin, a half-cape of storm-grey wool clipped at one shoulder.

Ranger: Oxblood fitted leather cuirass brass-riveted across the sternum over a cream linen underlayer, tooled bracers wrapping both forearms, a crossed sword-and-dagger harness riding her back, belt heavy with pouches, no cloak, boots mud-caked to the ankle.

Tribal Warrior: Dark chitin-and-hide breastplate lacquered deep teal and articulated at the waist like beetle-shell segments, layered chitin shoulder-guards over bare tattooed arms, a hammered-bronze gorget at the throat, a short curved blade sheathed low at the hip.

Assassin: Midnight-blue hardened-leather cuirass etched with interlocking serpent-scale patterns, close-fitted vambraces with hidden-blade channels along the inner forearm, a flat bandolier of throwing-spike sheaths across the chest, black linen underlayer, scarred across the right shoulder from a near miss.

Battlemage: Blackened-steel half-plate over a deep wine-red reinforced robe cut to mid-thigh, runic script chased in silver along the breastplate, articulated spaulders with ember-orange inlay, a leather-wrapped staff harness across the back, gauntlets etched with ward-circles at every knuckle.

Paladin: Polished bone-white plate with a cracked sun-burst crest hammered into the cuirass, brass-chased pauldrons dented from campaign use, a scarlet wool tabard road-frayed at the hem, sabatons worn smooth at the toe, gauntlets engraved with oath-script along the cuffs.

Warden: Forest-green brigandine of iron-riveted leather tiles over a grey chainmail hauberk, close-fitted pauldrons of hardened leather tooled with leaf-vein patterns, a twin-dagger hip harness, knee-high boots wrapped in trail-worn leather bindings, a compact recurve in a slung back-scabbard.

Spellsword: Fitted iron-grey lamellar cuirass over a frost-pale reinforced tunic, articulated vambraces inlaid with copper runic channels that glow faintly at the edges, a single short-sword in a hip scabbard stamped with ward-sigils, pauldrons of overlapping blackened steel, battle-scratched across the left plate.

Oathbreaker: Tarnished black-iron plate with the original order-crest half-chiseled off the breastplate, deep oxblood gambeson showing through the gaps, cracked greaves re-laced with raw leather cord, a heavy bastard-sword harness across the back, pauldrons mismatched from a battlefield salvage.

Tracker: Bog-green hardened-leather jerkin tooled with trail-maps and compass-rose patterns, snug vambraces of boiled leather stamped with distance-rune markings, a quiver slung across the back alongside a short recurve bow, knee-high travel boots caked in dark mud, a skinning blade at the left hip.

Hexblade: Deep violet lacquered scale-armor fitted over a reinforced black linen underlayer, shoulder-spaulders of carved bone etched with hex-circles, a cursed-looking rune chased in silver at the center of the breastplate, gauntlets wrapped with leather thongs over knuckle-iron, blade perpetually smoke-stained.

Shieldmaiden: Hammered iron-grey plate cuirass with a clan-sigil raised-relief at the sternum, wide riveted pauldrons flaring at the shoulder, a round-shield harness strapped across her back, a wool sash of storm-grey knotted at the waist over chainmail, greaves dented and re-polished in the field.

Scout: Fitted forest-green ranger-leather coat reinforced with hardened-leather chest-and-back panels, brass-riveted at the shoulders and sternum, slim vambraces etched with grid-and-contour line patterns, a single short-sword across the back, belt loaded with four pouches and a compass-case, collar worn and creased.

Inquisitor: Severe antique-brass half-plate over a midnight-blue quilted gambeson, the cuirass stamped with a sunburst-and-chain order seal, close-fitted greaves with rune-inscribed knee-cops, gauntlets of riveted leather over steel, a paired blade-and-rod harness at the hip, everything road-dusted and smoke-darkened.

Wildwalker: Fitted scale-armor of lacquered dark-brown chitin tiles over a moss-green linen underlayer, bark-textured hardened-leather pauldrons carved with forest-floor patterns, tooled bracers wrapping both forearms, a long hunting knife at the thigh, boot-wrappings of oiled leather laced to the knee.

Dragon-Slayer: Heavy dragonbone-panel cuirass articulated over a charred ember-orange gambeson, every bone segment etched with kill-tally lines, broad blackened-steel pauldrons dented from fang-strikes, a two-handed blade in a back-harness scratched with acid scoring, greaves re-welded at the left shin.

Vengeance-Paladin: Blackened plate engraved with fractured-halo motifs at every panel, wine-red underlayer visible at the joints, a cracked-visor half-helm clipped to her belt, heavy gauntlets etched with grievance-oaths in tight script, a war-hammer harness across the back, every surface smoke-patinated.

Outrider: Fitted oxblood leather cuirass over a brass-riveted brigandine underlayer, short articulated spaulders allowing full arm range, a saddlebag-style dual-pouch belt at the hip, vambraces tooled with horse-rune borders, a cavalry saber in a worn hip scabbard, boots spurred and road-scarred.

Demon-Hunter: Fitted midnight-blue plate inlaid with silver ward-circles at the sternum and vambraces, overlapping steel scale at the waist for flexibility, a twin short-sword back-harness, a bandolier of ward-vial pouches across the chest, greaves etched with banishment-script, pauldrons asymmetric from a healed slash.

Stormcaller: Articulated storm-grey half-plate with lightning-fork etchings chased in white brass across the cuirass, fitted over a frost-pale reinforced tunic, vambraces with copper-channel inlays at the forearm, a glaive harness across the back, pauldrons flaring wide, the right one lightning-scored and re-pinned.

Veteran Knight: Battered silver plate re-polished in patches, the original order-crest on the cuirass now a ghost-impression where new dents sit, a heavy charcoal wool tabard frayed at every edge, gauntlets repaired with mismatched leather, greaves engraved finely but deeply road-scuffed, a longsword in a scarred scabbard.

Bog-Witch: Fitted dark-iron scale-armor of lacquered iron-grey chitin over a deep green layered underlayer, articulated waist-plates allowing full crouch movement, vambraces carved with marsh-rune spirals, a belt of pouched glass-vials and dried-herb bundles, boots wrapped in waxed leather, every surface patinated with swamp-damp.

Glaive-Master: Iron-grey fitted brigandine reinforced with hardened-leather chest-panels riveted in antique brass, articulated at the waist and shoulders for wide overhead swings, slim vambraces tooled with blade-measurement runes, a tall glaive in a back-frame harness, greaves engraved with reach-guard knotwork, travel-dirtied to mid-thigh.

Wandering Captain: Fitted wine-red leather cuirass over a chainmail hauberk, every panel of the cuirass hand-tooled with campaign-map motifs, a single broad pauldron on the sword-side only, a short-sword and dispatch-case at the hip, vambraces stamped with a mercenary-company seal, the whole kit road-grimed and seasoned.

Paladin: Burnished antique-brass cuirass engraved with sunburst devotional panels, worn bright at the edges from long road use, fitted over a wine-red gambeson, articulated vambraces and tapered greaves, a sworn-order crest embossed at the sternum, travel-dust caked in every engraved line.
